svg.text: the Under-Stair → gully, ~140 m (150 m suit)
A raised coral-limestone island: pale domes undercut at the
waterline, sinkholes, a blue shaft. The reef, lifted into the air.

g.text: Ground level: boardwalk under the notch overhang, tide pool.

svg.text: Field station on the saddle shoulder
Mushroom islets on the lagoon rim
View from the pod, looking west (south ← → north), with the reef wreck's mast in front. Below the water: cutaway, depth compressed.
